decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the smaller-than-8-quart capacity and earlier-design size reference; no additional update or removal is required.
The bowl-size decision does not change the obligation to provide a basic electrical wiring plan.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing high-quality mixing, consistent foam, and their priority over larger capacity; no additional change is needed.
The selected bowl size may inform later component choices, but it does not change the current component-selection and BOM deliverable or its rapid-prototype goal.
Choosing smaller bowls does not change the required bottom spout, barista-facing orientation, or easy-pour goal.
Message 34 discusses bowl size and general aesthetics but does not change the existing green accent-color requirement.
The bowl-size decision does not alter the machine name or wording requirements.
The preference for smaller bowls is compatible with and motivated by the selected aesthetic, but it does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity itself.
The bowl-capacity decision does not change the valve mechanism, no-drip behavior, or controlled-flow requirements.
Smaller bowls do not modify the requirement to prevent leakage into the base and electronics.
The bowl-size choice does not change the rapid V1 prototype priority or the policy of using simple off-the-shelf components where practical.
The selected bowl capacity does not change the spout cleanability or removable-or-flushable cleaning method.
